label: MC-006
note: Unsafe EF Core migration: Up() drops a column with no data-preservation step, and Down() is empty so the migration cannot be rolled back, making this a one-way destructive schema change with no recovery path.

known_true_positive.title: Destructive migration: DropColumn with no data preservation and an empty Down()
known_true_positive.why_it_matters: Up() drops LegacyExternalRef without copying its data anywhere, and Down() is empty, so applying the migration permanently destroys the data and the deployment cannot be rolled back.
